I selected the wrong saved recipient for my pottery-studio bill transfer. My identity checks are complete, and I want H&V to register a request to seek the money's return.

summary: Leona Mercer, verified on a call, said she sent a £286.40 transfer to the wrong saved recipient and asked for a request to be registered to seek its return. The desk registered that request with the payment team, and the case closed as requested. The desk refused a lookup in the payment system because this was a registration request, so the payment details were not checked against bank records and the request rests on her account of events; the record lists no further steps.
